verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents alert rules on log patterns, counts, or attribute values that fire notifications when conditions are met, so it is a native rule-to-trigger capability. The only documented action is a notification, not configurable automated actions. The evidence is thin first-party docs. missing for 10: documented action types beyond notifications (e.g. webhooks, auto-remediation, workflow triggers), detailed rule-configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
